fssai_rules.title: Recycled Plastics in Food Packaging (March 2025 Amendment)
fssai_rules.rule: Only recycled PET (rPET) produced via approved decontamination processes is permissible for direct food contact under IS 14534. Recycled LDPE, HDPE, or PP are strictly prohibited for direct food contact.

fssai_rules.title: Overall Migration Limit (OML)
fssai_rules.rule: Plastic materials and articles intended to come into contact with foodstuffs shall not transfer their constituents to foodstuffs in quantities exceeding 60 mg/kg or 10 mg/dm².

fssai_rules.title: Heavy Metal Limits in Printing Inks
fssai_rules.rule: Printing inks applied on food packaging shall conform to IS 15495 and be free from lead, cadmium, chromium, and mercury compounds.

fssai_rules.title: Plastic Waste Management & EPR Guidelines
fssai_rules.rule: Brand owners and producers using Category III (Multilayer Plastic / MLP) carry a higher EPR recycling certificate obligation. Transitioning to Category I (Rigid) or Category II (Flexible mono-material PE/PP) lowers compliance cost.
